implemented: Provider-independent Dart contracts, geometry, lifecycle and progress engine
iOS native MapKit search, walking route, map and Core Location permission/updates
Shared speech adapter and foreground automatic readouts with reader/TTS exclusion
Versioned secure local favorites and recent ten places; Google ID-only provider cache
Android Maps/Places/location/speech adapters, task-owned wake flag and missing-service gates
Guest Routes callable with enforced App Check, fixed WALK request and Secret Manager parameter
Independent App Check activation, Android example configuration and legal drafts
test_coverage: Single jumps, duplicate cached fixes, crossings and parallel legs
Superseded search, late calculation and late wake acquisition
Stale timer, background cancellation and explicit resume
Five consecutive automatic voice searches and screen-reader exclusion of TTS
Backend attestation context, guest access, input validation, geometry, quota, timeout and fixed upstream
not_performed: iPhone installation, actual microphone and outdoor route acceptance
Android Kotlin/Gradle dependency resolution, APK build and native runtime tests; no Android SDK or Java configured
Google Maps/Places/Routes billing, API keys, cloud quotas, App Check device registration or callable deployment
Public hosting and owner contact completion of privacy/terms drafts
VoiceOver/TalkBack field studies, three route categories with repeated walks, calls/headsets, thirty-minute battery/thermal checks
limits: No background/lock-screen navigation, indoor floors, camera concurrency, route recording or verified step-free routing
GPS thresholds are engineering defaults requiring field calibration
Android Places pinned to 5.1.1 to retain fetchPlace; R8 workaround and desugaring added but Android build remains unverified
Unsigned iOS build is not installed or signed for the user; Android release signing remains development-only
